nodes.name: Evolution API Webhook
nodes.notes: Evolution API posts MESSAGES_UPSERT here. The path is -v2 because this workflow replaced an earlier one on 'hfs-receive-wa-file'; Evolution's webhook URL already points here, so the name is kept rather than renamed -- a path rename that misses Evolution fails silently (it posts into a 404: no execution, no error, files just vanish). IMPORTANT: 'Webhook Base64' must be OFF in Evolution (Events -> Webhook). With it ON the whole file arrives base64-encoded in this payload and n8n rejects anything over N8N_PAYLOAD_SIZE_MAX before a single node runs.

nodes.name: Filter: Media Only
nodes.notes: Only forward messages that contain a downloadable file. Text/reaction/status events are dropped.

nodes.name: Filter: Groups Only
nodes.notes: Only process messages from group chats (remoteJid ends with @g.us). Individual DMs are ignored.

nodes.name: Extract Media Metadata
nodes.notes: Pulls groupId / sender / messageId / fileName / mimeType / size / mediaUrl out of the Evolution payload. Throws with a clear message if mediaUrl is absent, which is the signal that S3_ENABLED is off or MinIO is unreachable.

nodes.name: POST to CRM Webhook
nodes.notes: Sends ~1KB of metadata. The CRM stats the object in MinIO to confirm it exists and to read its true size, then inserts the inbox_files row. URL and secret come from the n8n container's own env (CRM_BACKEND_URL, WEBHOOK_SECRET), which works because the stack sets N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false — so no secret is stored in this file. Retry: the backend waits up to MEDIA_WAIT_MS for a still-uploading object and returns 409 if it never lands; this node retries 3x/5s on top, so a slow large-file upload is picked up instead of dropped. The CRM dedups by messageId, so retries are safe.

parameters.errorMessage: CRM webhook returned an error — check execution log

nodes.name: Log Error
nodes.notes: The CRM webhook is idempotent (dedup by messageId), so a retry is safe. It now returns real 4xx/5xx responses instead of always 200, so failures surface as failed executions here rather than vanishing into the backend log.

notes: Evolution API setup (docker-compose.yml, service evolution-api) — BOTH are required:
1. S3_BUCKET must match the CRM's MINIO_BUCKET (hfc-documents). S3_ENABLED is already true; pointing it at a different bucket is why the CRM never saw the media.

2. Events -> Webhook -> 'Webhook Base64' switched OFF in the manager UI. With it ON the whole file arrives base64-encoded in this webhook's payload and n8n rejects anything over ~12MB with a 413 before any node runs.
Requires CRM_BACKEND_URL and WEBHOOK_SECRET on the n8n container (both already set).
Recommended on the n8n container: N8N_DEFAULT_BINARY_DATA_MODE=filesystem, and N8N_PAYLOAD_SIZE_MAX if any base64 fallback traffic is expected (default 16MB).
The bytes never pass through n8n or the CRM backend — only the MinIO object reference does. That is what lifts the old ~12MB ceiling to the full MAX_INBOX_FILE_MB (200MB).
Evolution API delivers ALL group messages from ALL monitored groups — the CRM resolves the right engagement by groupId
Files from groups not linked to any engagement are stored in unmatched_inbox for manual review
